mentions.name: pura
mentions.description: A crypto-based payment routing project aimed at AI agents. It uses cryptocurrency as a workaround for KYC requirements, since agents don't have bank accounts, and targets the payment routing market.
mentions.problem: AI agents don't have their own bank accounts, and the routing market is extremely competitive; crypto was chosen only as the way around KYC.
